lists.name: Pitchfork: The 200 Best Albums of the 2010s

podcast.body: Part of Björk's later artistic phase, this album, along with *Biophilia*, illustrates her transition into a prominent museum artist. It marks a significant collaboration with the Venezuelan singer, producer, and artist Arca, with whom she continuously works on audiovisual projects and video creations, further establishing her presence in modern art museums globally. "esta etapa ya podemos sacar pues por ejemplo el Black Lane o el último tema que acaba de sacar ahora mismo que nos deje esa situación en la que estamos ahora en la que Bjork ya ha dejado de ser una cantante para ser una de las artistas más importantes que tenemos."

The tour for *Vulnicura* concluded in 2017. This album was characterized by very sad, depressing, emotionally intense, and sometimes macabre lyrics. It also featured moments of arhythmic and experimental electronic sounds, such as in tracks like "Mouth Mantra" and "Notget," though these elements were less prominent or more "hidden" within the album's overall sound compared to *Utopia*. "La gira del volnicura había terminado durante este 2017."
